entities.summary: Kurakhove is a city in Pokrovsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine. Population: 18,220 ; 21,479 (2001). Kurakhove is home to the Kurakhove Power Station. The city has been under Russian occupation since December 2024, the power station since January 2025.
